title: FBI-UAP-D029, Digital Rendering, “Dark Triangle with Lights,” 2011
doc_notes: This document is a digital rendering created by the FBI in 2026 based on a 2011 sighting described in a separate report.

incidents.summary: A nighttime sighting of a large, dark, triangular craft with three circular white lights at each corner.
incidents.quote: a large, dark, triangular object hovers in a starry, dark blue sky
